scenes.name: title
scenes.narration: Vigil Watchtower: a post-quantum rollup with its own watchtower, on the QoreChain testnet.

scenes.name: home
scenes.caption: Vigil: a rollup that checks itself
scenes.narration: Every batch of the Vigil rollup is re-executed the moment it lands, and a wrong one is challenged before it can settle. On the right, the watchtower's live view.

scenes.name: overview
scenes.caption: The dashboard, live
scenes.narration: The dashboard shows the rollup right now: inbox entries, batches, re-executed batches, final batches and on-chain receipts.

scenes.name: signin
scenes.caption: Sign in to the operator wallet
scenes.narration: The operator wallet signs on the server. It opens with a password, typed here from the environment, or with Sign In With QoreChain.

scenes.name: transfer
scenes.caption: A rollup transfer, signed with ML-DSA-44
scenes.narration: Now a transfer to another rollup account. It is signed with M L D S A 44 and posted to the rollup's inbox on QoreChain.

scenes.name: batched
scenes.caption: Batched, and re-executed by the watchtower
scenes.narration: Seconds later the batcher submits a batch with an M L D S A 87 anchor. The watchtower re-executes it independently and marks it valid. The chain gives it one hour before it is final.

scenes.name: receipt
scenes.caption: Settlement recorded on chain
scenes.narration: Once final, the batch's post-quantum anchor is verified by the Vigil Receipts contract, which reads the signer's key from QoreChain's registry, and records it permanently.

scenes.name: memo
scenes.caption: Private memos, sealed with ML-KEM-1024
scenes.narration: Payments can carry a private memo, encrypted with M L KEM 1024 to the recipient's registered key, and bound to a signed transfer.

scenes.name: proof
scenes.caption: A forged batch, stopped in 5 seconds
scenes.narration: This really happened on the testnet. An attacker bonded a thousand Q O R and posted a forged batch. Two seconds later the watchtower found the wrong state root. Three seconds after that, its fraud proof was confirmed. The chain threw the batch out, and the attacker's bond was slashed.

scenes.name: rollups
scenes.caption: Auditing other teams' rollups
scenes.narration: The watchtower also re-executes every other rollup on the network, read-only. On wicketgate-pay it proved that batch 12 changed only its withdrawals root. That batch paid out 13 Q O R, and nobody challenged it.

scenes.name: gate
scenes.caption: Contracts can rely on settlement
scenes.narration: Contracts can rely on settlement. This escrow, made with create QoreChain dapp, paid out only once batch 29's receipt was recorded, and refused a forged state root. Withdrawn funds can also leave QoreChain: this exit reached Osmosis over I B C in 21 seconds.

scenes.name: learn
scenes.caption: Use cases, docs and one-command checks
scenes.narration: Use cases, docs, a red-team replay and every claim with its transaction are built in, and one command re-checks them all from a fresh clone, with no key.

scenes.name: end
scenes.narration: Vigil Watchtower. Post-quantum settlement that anyone can check. Open source under Apache 2.
